title: CertChainError::PathLenViolated declared but never produced
description: error.rs declares CertChainError::PathLenViolated but cert.rs never constructs it. The old code had explicit pathLen checking; the new pkix-chain delegation maps PE::PathTooLong to CertChainError::TooDeep (chain depth) rather than to PathLenViolated. Dead public enum variant.
